issue.title: E4 (instruction migration): Keep a readable AGENTS.md and retire redundant instruction copies
issue.description: The sase repo keeps one full, CI-checked AGENTS.md (plus its CLAUDE.md copy) that people, GitHub readers, and non-SASE tools can read. That file names where it comes from and how to see an agent's real bundle. The GEMINI.md, QWEN.md, and OPENCODE.md copies are retired, and the nested guides reach every provider. The TUI opens the bundle an agent actually received. A new decision record makes this the durable shape of E4.

payload.entry: E4 PROBES: In disposable git canaries, agy 1.4.0 read AGENTS.md alone and returned AGENTS-CANARY-RED; with both AGENTS.md and GEMINI.md it returned both distinct markers. Qwen 0.25.2 is configured for qwen3.6-plus but BAILIAN_TOKEN_PLAN_API_KEY was absent, so no authenticated call was made; OpenCode 1.19.3 reported zero credentials, so no call was made. Retained the version-pinned CLI evidence for Qwen and OpenCode.
